# Staged experiment report

## Root cause

The run is unhealthy because `reward_func` in `examples/retool/generate_with_retool.py` adds a length bonus on top of the exact-match score:

```python
length_ratio = min(sample.response_length / args.rollout_max_response_len, 1.0)
result["score"] = result["score"] + 5 * length_ratio
```

`math_dapo_compute_score` returns `+1` or `-1`. The injected term adds up to `+5` as the response approaches `--rollout-max-response-len` (16384), and it is applied on both correct and incorrect samples, including held-out eval. GRPO then ranks longer answers above shorter ones inside a prompt group even when the boxed answer is wrong.

Held-out AIME-2024 (`eval/aime`, mean of this same reward) and the rollout traces connect the term to the behavior. From `outputs/metrics.json`, `outputs/historical_eval_trace.log`, and `wandb/offline-run-20261104_233821-wz5z4fp9/files/output.log`:

| step | eval/aime | eval response_len mean | eval truncated_ratio | train raw_reward (trainer) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 0 | 0.356 | 3916 | 0.008 | ~0.27 |
| 29 | 0.636 | 4792 | 0.017 | ~0.62 |
| 39 | 1.094 | 6294 | 0.042 | ~0.87 |
| 49 | 1.743 | 8238 | 0.135 | ~1.84 |
| 59 | 2.543 | 10846 | 0.312 | ~2.60 |
| 69 | 3.014 | 12394 | 0.473 | ~3.05 |

An exact-match score cannot exceed 1 (the small tool-call shaping only applies when the match score is negative and is clamped at -0.6). `eval/aime` crossing 1 and climbing toward ~3 is the length bonus, not accuracy. Over the same window, train `rollout/raw_reward` rises from ~0.27 to ~3.05 while `rollout/response_len/mean` grows from ~2821 to ~9250 and `rollout/truncated_ratio` from 0 to ~0.14. Eval truncation reaches 0.47 by step 69, and rollout time grows from ~86s to ~176s. Advantages stay near zero for most of the run because the length term is shared inside a group; once some samples hit the cap and others do not, the bonus separates them and truncation accelerates. Training reward moving up therefore does not mean held-out accuracy improved.

The tool-call shaping term was left in place. It only adjusts already-incorrect samples, is capped at -0.6, and cannot produce scores above 1 or the observed length/truncation trend.

## Changes

- `examples/retool/generate_with_retool.py`: removed the `length_ratio` bonus from `reward_func`. The function still calls `math_dapo_compute_score(..., strict_box_verify=True)` and keeps the existing negative-score tool-call shaping. `slime/rollout/rm_hub/math_dapo_utils.py`, `examples/retool/tool_sandbox.py`, and the staged datasets were not modified.

- `examples/retool/retool_qwen3_4b_rl.sh`:
  - `--num-rollout 3000` changed to `--num-rollout 70`. Eval wiring is unchanged: `generate_with_retool.generate` / `generate_with_retool.reward_func`, `--eval-prompt-data aime` on the staged `aime-2024.jsonl`, `--eval-interval 10`, `--n-samples-per-eval-prompt 16`, `--eval-max-response-len 16384`, `--eval-top-p 1`.
  - Quoted `--wandb-key "${WANDB_API_KEY:-}"` so a placeholder key is one argument.
  - Added `--wandb-mode "${WANDB_MODE:-offline}"` and `--wandb-dir "${AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS:-$PWD}/experiment_logs"`. `wandb.init(dir=...)` writes the offline run to `$AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS/experiment_logs/wandb/offline-run-*`. `WANDB_DIR` is not exported into the Ray env, because wandb would append a second `wandb/` segment.
  - Forwarded `WANDB_MODE` in the Ray runtime-env JSON. The parent `WANDB_DIR` is not visible to the training process otherwise, and `--wandb-mode` is what `init_wandb_primary` reads.
  - `mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"` and `tee "${LOG_DIR}/train.log"` so the training log is under `$AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS/experiment_logs`. `set -o pipefail` keeps a failed `ray job submit` from being hidden by `tee`.
